run_REINFORCEAgent: run the REINFORCEAgent class to sample actions from a policy network using stochastic or greedy mode
run_compute_reinforce_loss: run compute_reinforce_loss to calculate baseline loss, policy loss, and entropy loss for REINFORCE training
run_run_reinforce: run the REINFORCE training loop that samples episodes, computes losses, and updates the agent optimizer
review_REINFORCEAgent_forward: review the REINFORCEAgent forward method that computes action probabilities, critic baseline, and sets workspace tensors
run_make_cartpole: run make_cartpole to create a CartPole-v0 gym environment wrapped with a TimeLimit for max episode steps
